description: Sites: lib.rs LintResult / Finding / Cow throughout, deviation.rs DeviatedFinding. The migration (PKIX-ua6q) from &'static str to Cow<'static, str> on detail / lint_id / citation fields is exactly right: static literals are zero-copy via Cow::Borrowed, runtime-formatted detail strings (format!('{actual} days exceeds {cap}')) use Cow::Owned and free on drop. A contributor will eventually say 'just use String' to simplify. Don't. The Cow form keeps the static-literal path zero-allocation, which matters for the high-volume Finding case (one Finding per lint per cert = thousands per chain in zlint-scale runs). String would allocate per Finding even for the common case of static detail. The de_cow_static helper at lib.rs:234-241 cleanly handles serde deserialization without leaking. The unit tests at lib.rs:2009-2022 pin the no-leak behavior. The serde feature gate keeps the de_cow_static helper out of the default build. This is the right shape for an advisory layer that produces lots of Findings.
title: Cow<'static, str> migration in LintResult / Finding / DeviatedFinding — defend against 'just use String'
